settings.title: Settings
settings.reducedMotionDesc: No screen shake, FOV kick or pulsing; calmer effects.
howto.title: How to play
howto.goalText: Eat glowing energy to grow longer. Make rivals crash their head into your body, then feast on what they leave behind. Your score is the peak length you reach in a single life.
howto.mouse: Mouse: the worm follows your cursor. Hold left or right click to boost.
howto.keys: Keyboard: A/D or ←/→ to turn, Space, W or ↑ to boost, Esc or P to pause.
howto.touch: Touch: drag anywhere on the left to steer, hold the right side to boost.
howto.pad: Gamepad: left stick to steer, A or RT to boost, Start to pause.
howto.boost: Boosting spends length. It leaves a trail of energy others can eat.
howto.celestialsText: Swallow a celestial body to gain a permanent power for this life. It becomes a glowing segment of your body. A green ring means you can eat it; a red number is the length you need.
howto.asteroid: Asteroids are solid. Touching one is fatal.
howto.gate: Energy gates flash orange, then switch on. They are fatal while lit.
howto.well: Gravity wells slow you and pull you in.
howto.rim: The glowing arena rim is fatal. A shield saves you once from any of these.
howto.teamText: Pass through your teammates harmlessly. The team with the greater total length when time runs out wins. You respawn after each life.
loading.slow: The network is slow. Play now with simplified visuals, or keep waiting.
howto.feastText: Chain bites to build a Feast combo; milestones pay bonus stardust. Rare prismatic Nova Motes are worth ten motes. The longest worm wears the Bounty Crown — devour the wearer to claim it and its stardust bounty.
hint.asteroid.title: Asteroid
hint.asteroid.text: Solid rock: touching it is fatal. Steer around the red striped ring.
hint.gate.title: Energy Gate
hint.gate.text: Fatal while lit red. It flashes amber before firing; cross when it is dim.
hint.well.title: Gravity Well
hint.well.text: Not fatal, but it slows you and pulls you in. Boost out or go around.
hint.rim.title: Arena Rim
hint.rim.text: The striped red edge of the arena is fatal. Turn back before you reach it.
hint.rival.title: Rival Worms
hint.rival.text: A red ring marks rivals you can't bite: their bodies are walls. ▲ means longer than you, so they win head-on clashes.
hint.ally.title: Teammates
hint.ally.text: In Team mode, blue rings mark allies. You pass through them safely.
tip.asteroid: Tip: asteroids sit inside red striped rings. A red reticle appears when you are on course to hit one.
tip.gate: Tip: gates flash amber before they fire. Wait for them to go dim before you cross.
tip.rim: Tip: the red striped band marks the arena edge. Turn early; the minimap shows how close you are.
tip.worm: Tip: rival bodies are walls. Follow the red reticle and edge arrows to spot them early.
tip.head: Tip: rivals marked ▲ are longer than you and win head-on clashes. Cut across their bodies instead.
tip.self: Tip: your own body is a wall too. Leave room to turn, and avoid tight spirals while boosting.
settings.threatsDesc: Full adds badges, a look-ahead reticle and edge arrows. Minimal keeps ground marks and colours only.
hint.edible.title: Edible celestial
hint.edible.text: A gold ring (gold on the minimap too) means you are big enough to swallow it for a permanent power.
hint.bite.title: Bite through smaller worms
hint.bite.text: Gold ring and ▼ mean you can bite their body: hit it with your head to cut them in two. Eat the spilled food.
